claim: ADR 0349 amendment 2026-11-01: EndpaperShell settles the leaf turn on Promise.allSettled of the runs' finished with a SETTLE_BACKSTOP_MS = LEAF_TURN.ms * 2 backstop, and no longer starts its settle timer at LEAF_TURN.ms beside runs that report finished.
verify: f=apps/web/src/components/brand/EndpaperShell.tsx; grep -q 'Promise.allSettled(runs.map((run) => run!.finished)).then(settle)' $f && grep -q 'const SETTLE_BACKSTOP_MS = LEAF_TURN.ms \* 2' $f && grep -q 'backstop = window.setTimeout(settle, SETTLE_BACKSTOP_MS)' $f
